site.name: Team yukimashou
site.heading: Let's go, together.
site.tagline: A volunteer team helping foreign residents and international students settle in and learn Japanese — through friendly seminars, conversation classes and community in Fukuoka.
site.taglineJp: 福岡で日本語と友だちが見つかる、ボランティアチームです。
site.about: “Team-Yukimashou!” is run by Japanese members and volunteers who were once newcomers to Japan themselves. We offer free and low-cost seminars and Japanese classes to make your life in Fukuoka feel a little warmer.
